```{r}
police <- read_csv("/Users/robwells/Downloads/Untitled spreadsheet - police data.csv")

```

#claude to the rescue
```{r}
data <- police %>%
  mutate(
    # Create location column: if UMPD Case Number is NA, 
    # use the Date Occurred value as location, otherwise NA
    Location = if_else(is.na(`UMPD Case Number`), 
                       `Date Occurred`,
                       NA_character_)
  ) %>%
  # Fill down the location to subsequent rows
  fill(Location, .direction = "down") %>%
  # Remove rows where UMPD Case Number is NA (the location header rows)
  filter(!is.na(`UMPD Case Number`))

```
